verdict.rationale: Metronome documents API/data-warehouse export of usage, invoices, and contract data (docs-10, docs-8, docs-33, docs-20 pagination) so finance leads can pull billing history out, but there is no evidence of exporting or porting stored payment methods to another provider — payment methods live in Stripe via Metronome's integration, not natively portable through Metronome. missing for 10: payment-method export/portability, a documented full-account data export/offboarding process, and any migration tooling for leaving the platform.
